sanskrit: kṣattā yad abravīd vākyaṃ janamadhye 'bruvann iva tvayā ca tat tathety ukto jānīmo na ca tad vayam
english: The words that Vidura spoke, as though speaking without speaking in public — that you replied 'so be it' to him — we do not know what that was.

sanskrit: yadi tac chakyam asmābhiḥ śrotuṃ na ca sadoṣavat śrotum icchāmi tat sarvaṃ saṃvādaṃ tava tasya ca
english: If it is possible for us to hear it, and if it contains nothing harmful, I wish to hear the entire conversation between you and him.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca viṣād agneś ca boddhavyam iti māṃ viduro 'bravīt panthāś ca vo nāviditaḥ kaś cit syād iti cābravīt
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: Vidura told me, "Beware of poison and of fire," and he also said, "Let no path remain unknown to you."

sanskrit: jitendriyaś ca vasudhāṃ prāpsyasīti ca mābravīt vijñātam iti tat sarvam ity ukto viduro mayā
english: He told me, "One who has conquered his senses will win the earth." I replied to Vidura, "All of this is understood."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca aṣṭame 'hani rohiṇyāṃ prayātāḥ phalgunasya te vāraṇāvatam āsādya dadṛśur nāgaraṃ janam
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Setting out on the eighth day of the lunar fortnight, on the day of Rohiṇī in the month of Phālguna, they arrived at Vāraṇāvata and beheld the citizens there.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tataḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo nagarād vāraṇāvatāt sarvamaṅgalasaṃyuktā yathāśāstram atandritāḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then all the subjects of the city of Vāraṇāvata, adorned with every auspicious article, according to scriptural injunction, with diligent care,

sanskrit: śrutvāgatān pāṇḍuputrān nānāyānaiḥ sahasraśaḥ abhijagmur naraśreṣṭhāñ śrutvaiva parayā mudā
english: Hearing of the arrival of the sons of Pāṇḍu, came forth in thousands with various conveyances to meet those best of men, with utmost joy, the very moment they heard the news.

sanskrit: te samāsādya kaunteyān vāraṇāvatakā janāḥ kṛtvā jayāśiṣaḥ sarve parivāryopatasthire
english: Those citizens of Vāraṇāvata, having approached the sons of Kuntī, all offered blessings of victory and stood surrounding them in attendance.

sanskrit: tair vṛtaḥ puruṣavyāghro dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ vibabhau devasaṃkāśo vajrapāṇir ivāmaraiḥ
english: Surrounded by them, that tiger among men, Dharmarāja Yudhiṣṭhira, shone like a god in appearance, like Vajrapāṇi amidst the immortals.

sanskrit: satkṛtās te tu pauraiś ca paurān satkṛtya cānaghāḥ alaṃkṛtaṃ janākīrṇaṃ viviśur vāraṇāvatam
english: Honoured by the citizens, and having in turn honoured the citizens, those sinless ones entered Vāraṇāvata, which was adorned and crowded with people.

sanskrit: te praviśya puraṃ vīrās tūrṇaṃ jagmur atho gṛhān brāhmaṇānāṃ mahīpāla ratānāṃ sveṣu karmasu
english: Having entered the city, those heroes quickly proceeded to the homes of the Brāhmaṇas, O protector of the earth, who were intent on their own duties,

sanskrit: nagarādhikṛtānāṃ ca gṛhāṇi rathināṃ tathā upatasthur naraśreṣṭhā vaiśyaśūdragṛhān api
english: and those best of men visited also the houses of the city's administrators and charioteers, and likewise the homes of Vaiśyas and Śūdras.

sanskrit: arcitāś ca naraiḥ pauraiḥ pāṇḍavā bharatarṣabhāḥ jagmur āvasathaṃ paścāt purocanapuraskṛtāḥ
english: Honoured by the citizens, those bulls among the Bharatas, the Pāṇḍavas, thereafter went to their residence, with Purocana leading the way.

sanskrit: tebhyo bhakṣyānnapānāni śayanāni śubhāni ca āsanāni ca mukhyāni pradadau sa purocanaḥ
english: Purocana provided them with food and drink fit for consumption, good beds, and excellent seats.

sanskrit: tatra te satkṛtās tena sumahārhaparicchadāḥ upāsyamānāḥ puruṣair ūṣuḥ puranivāsibhiḥ
english: There, honoured by him and furnished with very costly furnishings, attended upon by the men of the city, they dwelt.

sanskrit: daśarātroṣitānāṃ tu tatra teṣāṃ purocanaḥ nivedayām āsa gṛhaṃ śivākhyam aśivaṃ tadā
english: But after they had dwelt there for ten nights, Purocana then pointed out to them a house called "Śiva" (auspicious) — though it was truly inauspicious.

sanskrit: tatra te puruṣavyāghrā viviśuḥ saparicchadāḥ purocanasya vacanāt kailāsam iva guhyakāḥ
english: There those tigers among men entered with their belongings, at Purocana's word, like the Guhyakas entering mount Kailāsa.

sanskrit: tat tv agāram abhiprekṣya sarvadharmaviśāradaḥ uvācāgneyam ity evaṃ bhīmasenaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ jighran somya vasāgandhaṃ sarpir jatuvimiśritam
english: But examining that dwelling, Yudhiṣṭhira, versed in all righteousness, sniffing the scent of fat mixed with ghee and lac, said to Bhīmasena, "This is a fire-trap."

sanskrit: kṛtaṃ hi vyaktam āgneyam idaṃ veśma paraṃtapa śaṇasarjarasaṃ vyaktam ānītaṃ gṛhakarmaṇi muñjabalvajavaṃśādi dravyaṃ sarvaṃ ghṛtokṣitam
english: "Clearly this dwelling has been made as a fire-trap, O scorcher of foes — hemp and pine resin are plainly used in its construction, and all materials such as muñja-grass, reeds, and bamboo are thoroughly soaked in ghee."

sanskrit: śilpibhiḥ sukṛtaṃ hy āptaiḥ vinītair veśmakarmaṇi viśvastaṃ mām ayaṃ pāpo dagdhukāmaḥ purocanaḥ
english: "This was well constructed by trusted, skilled craftsmen versed in building — this wicked Purocana wishes to burn me when I am off-guard."

sanskrit: imāṃ tu tāṃ mahābuddhir viduro dṛṣṭavāṃs tadā āpadaṃ tena māṃ pārtha sa saṃbodhitavān purā
english: "It was this very danger that Vidura of great intellect foresaw, O Pārtha, and for that reason he warned me beforehand."

sanskrit: te vayaṃ bodhitās tena buddhavanto 'śivaṃ gṛham ācāryaiḥ sukṛtaṃ gūḍhair duryodhanavaśānugaiḥ
english: "We, having been warned by him, know this inauspicious house — well built by craftsmen who secretly follow Duryodhana's will."

sanskrit: bhīma uvāca yad idaṃ gṛham āgneyaṃ vihitaṃ manyate bhavān tatraiva sādhu gacchāmo yatra pūrvoṣitā vayam
english: Bhīma said: If you believe this dwelling to be a fire-trap as prepared, then it is well that we return to where we stayed before.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca iha yattair nirākārair vastavyam iti rocaye naṣṭair iva vicinvadbhir gatim iṣṭāṃ dhruvām itaḥ
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: I think we should remain here, vigilant and showing no outward sign — like those who are lost seeking a safe and certain path from here.

sanskrit: yadi vindeta cākāram asmākaṃ hi purocanaḥ śīghrakārī tato bhūtvā prasahyāpi daheta naḥ
english: "For if Purocana were to detect any sign from us, he would then act swiftly and burn us by force."

sanskrit: nāyaṃ bibhety upakrośād adharmād vā purocanaḥ tathā hi vartate mandaḥ suyodhanamate sthitaḥ
english: "This Purocana has no fear of public censure or of unrighteousness — for so does he behave, that dull-witted one, standing firm in Suyodhana's command."

sanskrit: api ceha pradagdheṣu bhīṣmo 'smāsu pitāmahaḥ kopaṃ kuryāt kimarthaṃ vā kauravān kopayeta saḥ dharma ity eva kupyeta tathānye kurupuṃgavāḥ
english: "And even if we were burned here, would our grandfather Bhīṣma become angry? And why would he anger the Kauravas? He would be angry only out of righteousness, and so would the other bulls of the Kurus."

sanskrit: vayaṃ tu yadi dāhasya bibhyataḥ pradravema hi spaśair no ghātayet sārvān rājyalubdhaḥ suyodhanaḥ
english: "But if we were to flee, fearing the fire, then Suyodhana, greedy for kingship, would have us all killed through his spies."

sanskrit: apadasthān pade tiṣṭhann apakṣān pakṣasaṃsthitaḥ hīnakośān mahākośaḥ prayogair ghātayed dhruvam
english: "One who stands secure in position would surely destroy those who have no footing; one with support would destroy those without allies; one with a great treasury would certainly destroy those with a depleted treasury, by his machinations."

sanskrit: tad asmābhir imaṃ pāpaṃ taṃ ca pāpaṃ suyodhanam vañcayadbhir nivastavyaṃ channavāsaṃ kva cit kva cit
english: "Therefore we must deceive this wicked man and that wicked Suyodhana as well, and dwell in concealment, moving from place to place."

sanskrit: te vayaṃ mṛgayāśīlāś carāma vasudhām imām tathā no viditā mārgā bhaviṣyanti palāyatām
english: "We, adopting the habit of hunting, shall roam this earth, and thus the paths for our escape will become known to us."

sanskrit: bhaumaṃ ca bilam adyaiva karavāma susaṃvṛtam gūḍhocchvasān na nas tatra hutāśaḥ saṃpradhakṣyati
english: "And let us this very day dig a well-concealed underground tunnel — breathing quietly there, the fire will not be able to consume us."

sanskrit: vasato 'tra yathā cāsmān na budhyeta purocanaḥ pauro vāpi janaḥ kaś cit tathā kāryam atandritaiḥ
english: "While we live here, we must act diligently so that neither Purocana nor any citizen of the town suspects us."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca vidurasya suhṛt kaś cit khanakaḥ kuśalaḥ kva cit vivikte pāṇḍavān rājann idaṃ vacanam abravīt
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: A certain friend of Vidura, a skilled digger, in a secluded spot, O king, spoke these words to the Pāṇḍavas:

sanskrit: prahito vidureṇāsmi khanakaḥ kuśalo bhṛśam pāṇḍavānāṃ priyaṃ kāryam iti kiṃ karavāṇi vaḥ
english: "I am sent by Vidura; I am highly skilled as a digger. My task is to do what is dear to the Pāṇḍavas — what shall I do for you?"

sanskrit: pracchannaṃ vidureṇoktaḥ śreyas tvam iha pāṇḍavān pratipādaya viśvāsād iti kiṃ karavāṇi vaḥ
english: "Vidura told me in secret, 'Secure the welfare of the Pāṇḍavas here with his full trust' — what shall I do for you?"

sanskrit: kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ rātrāv asya purocanaḥ bhavanasya tava dvāri pradāsyati hutāśanam
english: "On the fourteenth night of the dark fortnight, Purocana will set fire to the door of this dwelling of yours."

sanskrit: mātrā saha pradagdhavyāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ iti vyavasitaṃ pārtha dhārtarāṣṭrasya me śrutam
english: "The Pāṇḍavas, those bulls among men, along with their mother, are to be burned alive — thus is the resolve of Dhṛtarāṣṭra's son, as I have heard, O Pārtha."

sanskrit: kiṃ cic ca vidureṇokto mlecchavācāsi pāṇḍava tvayā ca tat tathety uktam etad viśvāsakāraṇam
english: "Moreover, Vidura spoke something to you in the Mleccha tongue, O Pāṇḍava, and you replied 'so be it' — this is the reason for my trust."

sanskrit: uvāca taṃ satyadhṛtiḥ kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ abhijānāmi saumya tvāṃ suhṛdaṃ vidurasya vai
english: Yudhiṣṭhira, the son of Kuntī, firm in truth, said to him: "I recognise you, gentle one, as indeed a friend of Vidura."

sanskrit: śucim āptaṃ priyaṃ caiva sadā ca dṛḍhabhaktikam na vidyate kaveḥ kiṃ cid abhijñānaprayojanam
english: "Pure, trustworthy, dear, and ever of firm devotion — there is no need of any further proof of recognition from the wise one."

sanskrit: yathā naḥ sa tathā nas tvaṃ nirviśeṣā vayaṃ tvayi bhavataḥ sma yathā tasya pālayāsmān yathā kaviḥ
english: "As he is to us, so are you to us — we make no distinction between you. We are yours as we are his. Protect us as the wise one would."

sanskrit: idaṃ śaraṇam āgneyaṃ madartham iti me matiḥ purocanena vihitaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya śāsanāt
english: "It is my conviction that this shelter — a fire-trap — was arranged by Purocana for my destruction, at the command of Dhṛtarāṣṭra's son."

sanskrit: sa pāpaḥ kośavāṃś caiva sasahāyaś ca durmatiḥ asmān api ca duṣṭātmā nityakālaṃ prabādhate
english: "That wicked one, possessed of a treasury and with allies, the evil-minded, wicked-souled one — he harasses us constantly at all times."

sanskrit: sa bhavān mokṣayatv asmān yatnenāsmād dhutāśanāt asmāsv iha hi dagdheṣu sakāmaḥ syāt suyodhanaḥ
english: "May you, with effort, deliver us from this fire — for if we are burned here, Suyodhana would have his wish fulfilled."

sanskrit: samṛddham āyudhāgāram idaṃ tasya durātmanaḥ vaprānte niṣpratīkāram āśliṣyedaṃ kṛtaṃ mahat
english: "This is an arsenal of that evil-souled one, built at the edge of the rampart, inescapable — this great construction."

sanskrit: idaṃ tad aśubhaṃ nūnaṃ tasya karma cikīrṣitam prāg eva viduro veda tenāsmān anvabodhayat
english: "This is surely that inauspicious deed he intended to do — Vidura knew it beforehand, and for that reason he warned us."

sanskrit: seyam āpad anuprāptā kṣattā yāṃ dṛṣṭavān purā purocanasyāviditān asmāṃs tvaṃ vipramocaya
english: "This is the very danger that Kṣattā foresaw before — while Purocana remains unaware of us, deliver us from it."

sanskrit: sa tatheti pratiśrutya khanako yatnam āsthitaḥ parikhām utkiran nāma cakāra sumahad bilam
english: Having promised "so be it," the digger applied himself diligently and, excavating a trench, made a very large underground tunnel.

sanskrit: cakre ca veśmanas tasya madhye nātimahan mukham kapāṭayuktaṃ ajñātaṃ samaṃ bhūmyā ca bhārata
english: And he made in the middle of that dwelling a not-too-large opening fitted with a door, unknown to others and level with the ground, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: purocanabhayāc caiva vyadadhāt saṃvṛtaṃ mukham sa tatra ca gṛhadvāri vasaty aśubhadhīḥ sadā
english: Out of fear of Purocana, he kept the opening covered; and that one of inauspicious mind (Purocana) dwelt always at the door of the house.

sanskrit: tatra te sāyudhāḥ sarve vasanti sma kṣapāṃ nṛpa divā caranti mṛgayāṃ pāṇḍaveyā vanād vanam
english: There they all dwelt, armed, through the nights, O king, and by day the sons of Pāṇḍu went hunting from forest to forest.

sanskrit: viśvastavad aviśvastā vañcayantaḥ purocanam atuṣṭās tuṣṭavad rājann ūṣuḥ paramaduḥkhitāḥ
english: Appearing trusting though they trusted not, deceiving Purocana, appearing content though discontented, O king, they dwelt in the utmost misery.

sanskrit: na cainān anvabudhyanta narā nagaravāsinaḥ anyatra vidurāmātyāt tasmāt khanakasattamāt
english: And the men dwelling in the city did not come to know of them — except for the minister Vidura and that best of diggers.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tāṃs tu dṛṣṭvā sumanasaḥ parisaṃvatsaroṣitān viśvastān iva saṃlakṣya harṣaṃ cakre purocanaḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Seeing them apparently cheerful, having dwelt there for a full year, and noting that they appeared quite at ease, Purocana felt joy.

sanskrit: purocane tathā hṛṣṭe kaunteyo 'tha yudhiṣṭhiraḥ bhīmasenārjunau caiva yamau covāca dharmavit
english: When Purocana was thus rejoicing, Yudhiṣṭhira, the son of Kuntī and knower of righteousness, then spoke to Bhīmasena, Arjuna, and the twins:

sanskrit: asmān ayaṃ suviśvastān vetti pāpaḥ purocanaḥ vañcito 'yaṃ nṛśaṃsātmā kālaṃ manye palāyane
english: "This wicked Purocana believes us to be fully at ease — this cruel-souled one has been deceived. I think the time for flight has come."

sanskrit: āyudhāgāram ādīpya dagdhvā caiva purocanam ṣaṭ prāṇino nidhāyeha dravāmo 'nabhilakṣitāḥ
english: "Setting fire to the arsenal and burning Purocana as well, and leaving six living bodies here, let us flee undetected."

sanskrit: atha dānāpadeśena kuntī brāhmaṇabhojanam cakre niśi mahad rājann ājagmus tatra yoṣitaḥ
english: Then, under the pretext of charity, Kuntī gave a great feast to Brāhmaṇas by night, O king, and women came there.

sanskrit: tā vihṛtya yathākāmaṃ bhuktvā pītvā ca bhārata jagmur niśi gṛhān eva samanujñāpya mādhavīm
english: They, having enjoyed themselves as they wished, having eaten and drunk, O Bhārata, departed in the night to their homes, taking leave of Mādhavī (Kuntī).

sanskrit: niṣādī pañcaputrā tu tasmin bhojye yadṛcchayā annārthinī samabhyāgāt saputrā kālacoditā
english: But a Niṣāda woman with five sons, seeking food, came to that feast by chance, driven by fate, together with her sons.

sanskrit: sā pītvā madirāṃ mattā saputrā madavihvalā saha sarvaiḥ sutai rājaṃs tasminn eva niveśane suṣvāpa vigatajñānā mṛtakalpā narādhipa
english: She, having drunk wine, was intoxicated, she and her sons overcome with intoxication, and together with all her sons, O king, she fell fast asleep in that very dwelling, bereft of consciousness, like one dead, O lord of men.

sanskrit: atha pravāte tumule niśi supte jane vibho tad upādīpayad bhīmaḥ śete yatra purocanaḥ
english: Then, when the wind was blowing fiercely, in the night, when the people had fallen asleep, O lord, Bhīma set fire to the place where Purocana slept.

sanskrit: tataḥ pratāpaḥ sumahāñ śabdaś caiva vibhāvasoḥ prādurāsīt tadā tena bubudhe sa janavrajaḥ
english: Then a very great blaze and a loud crackling of the fire arose, and by that the crowd of people was awakened.

sanskrit: paurā ūcuḥ duryodhanaprayuktena pāpenākṛtabuddhinā gṛham ātmavināśāya kāritaṃ dāhitaṃ ca yat
english: The citizens said: "That wicked one of perverted intellect, urged on by Duryodhana, had this house built and set on fire — for his own destruction."

sanskrit: aho dhig dhṛtarāṣṭrasya buddhir nātisamañjasī yaḥ śucīn pāṇḍavān bālān dāhayām āsa mantriṇā
english: "Alas, shame on Dhṛtarāṣṭra's intention — it is not at all proper — he who caused the innocent, young Pāṇḍavas to be burned by his minister."

sanskrit: diṣṭyā tv idānīṃ pāpātmā dagdho 'yam atidurmatiḥ anāgasaḥ suviśvastān yo dadāha narottamān
english: "By good fortune, this evil-souled one of utterly perverted mind is now burned — he who would have burned these best of men, who were innocent and had trusted him completely."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca evaṃ te vilapanti sma vāraṇāvatakā janāḥ parivārya gṛhaṃ tac ca tasthū rātrau samantataḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Thus the citizens of Vāraṇāvata lamented, and surrounding that house, they stood on all sides through the night.

sanskrit: pāṇḍavāś cāpi te rājan mātrā saha suduḥkhitāḥ bilena tena nirgatya jagmur gūḍham alakṣitāḥ
english: And the Pāṇḍavas too, O king, deeply distressed, together with their mother, came out through that tunnel and went away in secret, undetected.

sanskrit: tena nidroparodhena sādhvasena ca pāṇḍavāḥ na śekuḥ sahasā gantuṃ saha mātrā paraṃtapāḥ
english: But the Pāṇḍavas, those scorchers of enemies, on account of that lack of sleep and from exhaustion, were unable to move quickly along with their mother.

sanskrit: bhīmasenas tu rājendra bhīmavegaparākramaḥ jagāma bhrātṝn ādāya sarvān mātaram eva ca
english: But Bhīmasena, O king of kings, of terrifying speed and prowess, went forward, taking all his brothers and their mother as well.

sanskrit: skandham āropya jananīṃ yamāv aṅkena vīryavān pārthau gṛhītvā pāṇibhyāṃ bhrātarau sumahābalau
english: That mighty one placed his mother on his shoulder, held the twins in his lap, and grasped the two Pārthas — those brothers of immense strength — with his hands.

sanskrit: tarasā pādapān bhañjan mahīṃ padbhyāṃ vidārayan sa jagāmāśu tejasvī vātaraṃhā vṛkodaraḥ
english: Swiftly snapping trees and splitting the earth with his feet, that radiant Vṛkodara, swift as the wind, advanced rapidly.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca atha rātryāṃ vyatītāyām aśeṣo nāgaro janaḥ tatrājagāma tvarito didṛkṣuḥ pāṇḍunandanān
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then, when the night had passed, the entire populace of the city came there in haste, wishing to see the sons of Pāṇḍu.

sanskrit: nirvāpayanto jvalanaṃ te janā dadṛśus tataḥ jātuṣaṃ tad gṛhaṃ dagdham amātyaṃ ca purocanam
english: While extinguishing the fire, those people then saw that house of lac burnt to ashes, and the minister Purocana burned as well.

sanskrit: nūnaṃ duryodhanenedaṃ vihitaṃ pāpakarmaṇā pāṇḍavānāṃ vināśāya ity evaṃ cukruṣur janāḥ
english: "Surely this was arranged by the evil-acting Duryodhana for the destruction of the Pāṇḍavas" — thus did the people cry out.

sanskrit: vidite dhṛtarāṣṭrasya dhārtarāṣṭro na saṃśayaḥ dagdhavān pāṇḍudāyādān na hy enaṃ pratiṣiddhavān
english: "Dhṛtarāṣṭra's son, without doubt, burned the heirs of Pāṇḍu with Dhṛtarāṣṭra's knowledge — for he (Dhṛtarāṣṭra) did not restrain him."

sanskrit: nūnaṃ śāṃtanavo bhīṣmo na dharmam anuvartate droṇaś ca viduraś caiva kṛpaś cānye ca kauravāḥ
english: "Surely Bhīṣma, the son of Śāntanu, does not follow righteousness, nor does Droṇa, nor Vidura, nor Kṛpa, nor the other Kauravas."

sanskrit: te vayaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya preṣayāmo durātmanaḥ saṃvṛttas te paraḥ kāmaḥ pāṇḍavān dagdhavān asi
english: "We send word to that evil-souled Dhṛtarāṣṭra: your supreme desire is fulfilled — you have burned the Pāṇḍavas."

sanskrit: tato vyapohamānās te pāṇḍavārthe hutāśanam niṣādīṃ dadṛśur dagdhāṃ pañcaputrām anāgasam
english: Then, as they cleared away the fire in search of the Pāṇḍavas, they saw the Niṣāda woman burned — she of five sons, who was innocent.
